@graph.schema:name: Data from the development of 100 Ah LFP-graphite prismatic battery cells
@graph.dcterms:title: Data from the development of 100 Ah LFP-graphite prismatic battery cells
@graph.schema:description: Time-series test data from the development of the Morrow Batteries IFpP45-173-115-B, a 100 Ah LFP-graphite prismatic cell. The 400 files in the Battery Data Format (parquet) come from 142 test runs on 110 cells and cover cycle life, storage, rate capability, HPPC, SOC-OCV, capacity and charge retention between -20 and 60 °C. Version 1.0.0 replaces the CSV files of version 0.1.0 with corrected parquet copies and adds machine-readable metadata. Version 1.0.1 keeps the data files of 1.0.0 unchanged and regenerates the metadata files, so that each data file has its own distribution identifier in the deposit graph. README.md describes the files and the corrections.
